title: gel comfort seat pad
text: gel comfort seat pad. Husband travels 300 days a year... this is his "go to" comfort, even before a neck pillow.  (He is a big guy)..  He had his backpack stolen for the first time in 15 years in Houston and this pad was in it.  Soooo... this was one of the first things he replaced.  It is black, with a nylon material covering.  It doesn't come off, but easily wipes off.  I spray it with cloth sanitizer when he get back home.  It does fold in half as it appears in the photo, and the handles are really handy.. he drapes them over his carry on handle bag and stores in his backpack. If you travel a lot.. or have a need for extra padding on any chair, I would think this pad is definitely worth a shot.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
